lead.headline: Two mail-order suppliers took $593.6M of the $649.2M Medicare paid for one kind of wound dressing (alginate) in 2024
lead.number: $593,632,181 of $649,233,082 (91.4%); one claim per patient a year, carrying 494 dressings (Sunshine Senior Solutions) and 359 (Almaz Med Supply) vs 55 per claim elsewhere; 5-11x peers per patient
lead.watch_out: Almaz is on no ban list, and its absence from Medicare's enrollment file (PECOS) is normal for new big billers, so it proves nothing; drop "1.35 a day."

From in or around November 2024 through in or around September 2025, Sunshine Senior submitted at least $3.34 billion in false and fraudulent claims to Medicare, the FEHBP, Medicaid, and Commercial Insurers for DME and wound dressings that were medically unnecessary and not provided. Of this, at least $1. 78 billion was processed as paid by these insurers, with nearly the entirety of that amount held in suspension by Medicare Part B.
